summary: Completed testing of Visual ETL Mapping Editor feature. The editor successfully loads at /etl/mappings route with all major UI components working. Backend APIs return correct data (9 canonical entities from YAML). Minor issue found with React Flow relationship diagram edges not rendering due to missing Handle components.

ui_bugs.issue: React Flow edges not rendering - nodes missing Handle components for connections
ui_bugs.details: Console shows 'Couldn't create edge for source handle id: undefined' for all 10 relationships. The EntityNode custom component needs to add Handle components (source and target) to enable edge connections.

passed_tests: Visual Mapping Editor loads at /etl/mappings route
All 5 header buttons present and clickable (Refresh, Preview, Save, Schedule, Sync Now)
All 3 tabs present and functional (Field Mappings, Relationships, Sync Status)
Source Panel displays 'No models discovered' message when no connection selected
Target Panel displays all 9 canonical entities (sales_user, sales_team, account, contact, opportunity, activity, invoice, task, employee)
Target Panel shows entity fields with proper badges (PK, REQ, FK)
Relationships tab shows React Flow diagram with 9 entity nodes positioned correctly
Sync Status tab displays sync statistics and recent runs section
Backend API /api/mapping-editor/entities returns 9 entities from YAML
Backend API /api/mapping-editor/config returns default config structure
Save button clickable and triggers save action
Tab navigation works correctly between all three tabs

items.issue: React Flow relationship diagram edges not rendering
items.fix: Add Handle components to EntityNode custom component. Import Handle and Position from reactflow, then add source and target handles to the EntityNode component (around line 48-69). Example: <Handle type='source' position={Position.Right} /> and <Handle type='target' position={Position.Left} />
items.impact: Users cannot see the 10 relationship connections between entities in the Relationships tab, though the nodes are visible
